text:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — finalizing the design partner cohort for the Private (VPC/HSM) beta. Need agreement on recruitment targets, feedback cadence, and what counts as a successful pilot. TL;DR: 6 partners, 30–45 day pilots, three success metrics (integration, perf, security).

Owen Patel: +1. Who are our target verticals? Finserv + healthcare?

Maya Chen: Yes — start with fintech and health (regulated). Also 1x large ecommerce infra team for scale pattern.

Priya Singh: Can we add one startup that's multi-tenant SaaS to validate onboarding flow? small but likely to hit edge-case prompts.

Maya Chen: Good call. So target: 2 fintech/health (enterprise), 1 ecommerce, 1 SaaS startup, 2 wildcard (customer-chosen).

Liam Reyes: Timeline check: recruiting this week, kickoff next Tue, 30-day run + 14-day wrap (metrics collection). Is that firm?

Maya Chen: Recruiting window: 7 days. Kickoff target: 2025-11-10. Pilot phase flexible 30–45 days depending on integration complexity.

Carol Nguyen: For recruitment messaging, we should be explicit about: data residency, KMS/HSM, private control plane, and what we need (logs, access window). Draft outreach copy ready to share.

Owen Patel: What are the must-have acceptance criteria from product side?

Maya Chen: Proposed launch/acceptance gates for each partner: 1) End-to-end integration validated (deployment + testlatent traces) 2) Latency within agreed SLO (p50 < 80ms, p95 < 300ms) for 512-token generation baseline 3) No critical security gaps in onboarding checklist (KMS integrated, audit logs enabled) 4) Feedback loop engaged (>= 8 substantive eval items per partner).

Priya Singh: On #4, define "substantive eval items" — I'd say: prompt families + labeled regressions, priority-severity tags, and triage ticket created in our board.

Maya Chen: Agree. Let's standardize to: each partner provides 8 prompt families with 10 examples each, and flags 2 blockers (severity P0/P1) if any.

Liam Reyes: How do we measure integration effort? We should track days-to-first-successful-call and infra effort (FTE days).

Maya Chen: Add two operational KPIs: A) Days to first successful inference call (target <= 7 calendar days) B) Engineering touchpoints (<= 5 full days equivalent)

Carol Nguyen: Regarding contractual asks — legal wants a light NDA + DP agreement that includes feedback sharing rights and anonymized case study opt-in. Any objections?

Owen Patel: No objections. Also we should include a rollback plan for partners if we introduce risky changes during pilot.

Maya Chen: Noted. We'll add a rollback SLA and a model fallback policy into the DP agreement.

Priya Singh: Feedback cadence proposal: weekly async notes + a 60–90 minute mid-pilot review + final deep-dive. Also monthly product check-ins post-pilot for 3 months.

Maya Chen: That sounds reasonable. We'll require partners to join the weekly triage channel (invite-only).

Liam Reyes: What about measurement tooling? We should provide: 1) per-request traces via console, 2) a small infra sensor script to capture token-level latency, 3) an eval template (CSV) for partners to upload.

Maya Chen: I'll attach the eval template to outreach. Use this placeholder link in the message: https://redwood-internal.example/eval-template.csv

dp-bot: NOTE: New DP cohort created: cohort-id dp-priv-2025-11. Automated invites queued for 6 recipients.

Carol Nguyen: Recruitment screener draft (two quick Qs): 1) Use case & compliance requirements 2) Expected QPS + peak concurrency. Keep it short.

Maya Chen: Agreed. Also ask: "Do you need on-prem (air-gapped) or VPC?" and "Do you have an assigned security contact?"

Priya Singh: Incentives: offer 3 months of discounted Dedicated credits + 1:1 onboarding engineering time (up to 5 days). That should get signups.

Owen Patel: Can we promise a production SLA for partners during pilot? Maybe a limited SLA: 99.9% uptime for the reserved capacity windows. Need ops buy-in.

Liam Reyes: Ops says limited SLA during pilot is OK if we cap concurrency and have maintenance windows. We'll document maintenance windows in the kickoff.

Maya Chen: Final list of success metrics to include in outreach: a) Integration time (days to first call) b) Perf SLOs (p50/p95 thresholds) c) Feedback engagement (>=8 eval items) d) Business outcome signal (partner willingness to commit to Dedicated)

Carol Nguyen: For negotiation: be prepared to accept 45-day pilots for large enterprise integrations. We'll log scope trades: extra engineering time vs longer pilot window.

Priya Singh: Quick ops question — do partners need to provide synthetic traffic for load tests or will Redwood provide a replay harness?

Liam Reyes: We'll provide a replay harness but ask partners to validate real prompts after integration. Replay helps for perf reproducibility.

Maya Chen: Action items: @Carol — finalize outreach + screener by EOD tomorrow. @Owen — share DP agreement checklist with legal. @Liam — prepare replay harness + instrumentation docs. @Priya — finalize eval template and upload link. I'll run a small pilot shortlist and post invites Friday.

Owen Patel: On it.

Priya Singh: I'll push the template and sample CSV today.

Carol Nguyen: Draft will be in #product/outreach-drafts by 1400 PT.

Liam Reyes: Replay harness repo: https://git.redwood/replay-harness (private). I'll add a how-to snippet in the doc.

Maya Chen: Thanks team. If anyone else wants to join the invite review on Friday morning, ping me.

dp-bot: Reminder scheduled: DP kickoff on 2025-11-10 09:00 PT — calendar invites will be sent to confirmed partners."
